Name: Coffee and Tea Maker
Author: emurphy42
Description:
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]About 10% of the time, the Coffee Maker will produce Green Tea instead of coffee.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=1]Anything else that it produces is indicative of a manufacturing defect, and you should return your Coffee Maker to the Sirius Cybernetics Corporation for a full refund. (Offer void in Ferngill.)[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Props to [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/1tqs8nr/comment/ook3yjw/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web3x&utm_name=web3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button]u/PeaTearGriphon[/url] for inspiring this mod.[/size][/color]
